sanskrit: viśeṣeṇa tu sugrīvo hanumatyartham uktavān sa hi tasmin hariśreṣṭhe niścitārtho 'rthasādhane
english: Sugrīva spoke in particular on behalf of Hanūmān, for he was resolved in his purpose upon that foremost of monkeys as the one to accomplish the task.

sanskrit: na bhūmau nāntarikṣe vā nāmbare nāmarālaye nāpsu vā gatisaṃgaṃ te paśyāmi haripuṃgava
english: "I see no obstacle to your movement, O bull among monkeys — not on earth, nor in the atmosphere, nor in the sky, nor in the abode of the gods, nor in the waters."

sanskrit: sāsurāḥ sahagandharvāḥ sanāganaradevatāḥ viditāḥ sarvalokās te sasāgaradharādharāḥ
english: "All the worlds are known to you — together with the asuras, the gandharvas, the nāgas, the humans, and the gods, along with the oceans and the mountains."

sanskrit: gatir vegaś ca tejaś ca lāghavaṃ ca mahākape pitus te sadṛśaṃ vīra mārutasya mahaujasaḥ
english: "Your speed of movement, your swiftness, your energy, and your agility are equal to those of your father, the mighty-vigoured Māruta, O great monkey, O hero."

sanskrit: tejasā vāpi te bhūtaṃ samaṃ bhuvi na vidyate tad yathā labhyate sītā tattvam evopapādaya
english: "There exists no being on earth equal to you in splendour. Therefore, demonstrate in truth how Sītā may be found."

sanskrit: tvayy eva hanumann asti balaṃ buddhiḥ parākramaḥ deśakālānuvṛttaś ca nayaś ca nayapaṇḍita
english: "In you alone, O Hanūmān, O learned in statecraft, reside strength, wisdom, valour, and the policy of conforming to the demands of place and time."

sanskrit: tataḥ kāryasamāsaṃgam avagamya hanūmati viditvā hanumantaṃ ca cintayām āsa rāghavaḥ
english: Then Rāghava, understanding the urgency of the task to be accomplished by Hanūmān, and knowing Hanūmān's nature, reflected within himself.

sanskrit: sarvathā niścitārtho 'yaṃ hanūmati harīśvaraḥ niścitārthataraś cāpi hanūmān kāryasādhane
english: "The lord of the monkeys is wholly resolved upon Hanūmān for this purpose, and Hanūmān himself is even more firmly resolved in the accomplishment of the task."

sanskrit: tad evaṃ prasthitasyāsya parijñātasya karmabhiḥ bhartrā parigṛhītasya dhruvaḥ kāryaphalodayaḥ
english: "For one thus dispatched, thoroughly known by his deeds, and taken up by his lord — the fruit of the task is certain to arise."

sanskrit: taṃ samīkṣya mahātejā vyavasāyottaraṃ harim kṛtārtha iva saṃvṛttaḥ prahṛṣṭendriyamānasaḥ
english: Seeing that monkey of supreme determination, the great-splendoured one felt as if his purpose were already accomplished, his senses and mind filled with joy.

sanskrit: dadau tasya tataḥ prītaḥ svanāmāṅkopaśobhitam aṅgulīyam abhijñānaṃ rājaputryāḥ paraṃtapaḥ
english: Then the scorcher of foes, filled with affection, gave him his signet ring adorned with his own name inscribed upon it, as a token of recognition for the princess.

sanskrit: anena tvāṃ hariśreṣṭha cihnena janakātmajā matsakāśād anuprāptam anudvignānupaśyati
english: "By this token, O foremost of monkeys, the daughter of Janaka will look upon you as come from my presence, and will be reassured."

sanskrit: vyavasāyaś ca te vīra sattvayuktaś ca vikramaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṃdeśaḥ siddhiṃ kathayatīva me
english: "Your resolution, O hero, and your valour combined with fortitude, together with the message of Sugrīva, seem to declare success to me."

sanskrit: sa tad gṛhya hariśreṣṭhaḥ sthāpya mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ vanditvā caraṇau caiva prasthitaḥ plavagottamaḥ
english: Taking that ring, the foremost of monkeys placed it upon his head, bowed with joined palms, paid reverence to Rāma's feet, and set forth — that best of leapers.

sanskrit: sa tat prakarṣan hariṇāṃ balaṃ mahad babhūva vīraḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapi gatāmbude vyomni viśuddhamaṇḍalaḥ śaśīva nakṣatragaṇopaśobhitaḥ
english: Urging onward the great army of monkeys, the heroic son of the Wind became like the moon with its clear disc in a sky cleared of clouds, adorned by the host of stars.

sanskrit: atibalabalam āśritas tavāhaṃ harivaravikramavikramair analpaiḥ pavanasuta yathābhigamyate sā janakasutā hanumaṃs tathā kuruṣva
english: "Relying on your exceedingly mighty strength and the many feats of valour befitting the foremost of monkeys, O son of the Wind, do whatever is necessary so that the daughter of Janaka may be reached, O Hanūmān."

sanskrit: tad ugraśāsanaṃ bhartur vijñāya haripuṃgavāḥ śalabhā iva saṃchādya medinīṃ saṃpratasthire
english: Understanding the stern command of their lord, those foremost of monkeys set forth, covering the earth like locusts.

sanskrit: rāmaḥ prasravaṇe tasmin nyavasat sahalakṣmaṇaḥ pratīkṣamāṇas taṃ māsaṃ yaḥ sītādhigame kṛtaḥ
english: Rāma resided there on mount Prasravaṇa together with Lakṣmaṇa, awaiting that month which had been appointed for the finding of Sītā.

sanskrit: uttarāṃ tu diśaṃ ramyāṃ girirājasamāvṛtām pratasthe sahasā vīro hariḥ śatabalis tadā
english: The heroic monkey Śatabali then swiftly set out toward the northern quarter, beautiful and encompassed by the king of mountains.

sanskrit: pūrvāṃ diśaṃ prati yayau vinato hariyūthapaḥ
english: Vinatā, the leader of the monkey troop, marched toward the eastern quarter.

sanskrit: tārāṅgadādi sahitaḥ plavagaḥ pavanātmajaḥ agastyacaritām āśāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ hariyūthapaḥ
english: The son of the Wind, that leaping monkey who leads the monkey host, set out toward the southern quarter — the region traversed by Agastya — accompanied by Tārā, Aṅgada, and others.

sanskrit: paścimāṃ tu diśaṃ ghorāṃ suṣeṇaḥ plavageśvaraḥ pratasthe hariśārdūlo bhṛśaṃ varuṇapālitām
english: Suṣeṇa, the lord of leaping monkeys, that tiger among monkeys, set forth toward the formidable western quarter, guarded exceedingly by Varuṇa.

sanskrit: tataḥ sarvā diśo rājā codayitvā yathā tatham kapisenā patīn mukhyān mumoda sukhitaḥ sukham
english: Then the king, having dispatched in due order the chief leaders of the monkey army to all the quarters, rejoiced in full contentment.

sanskrit: evaṃ saṃcoditāḥ sarve rājñā vānarayūthapāḥ svāṃ svāṃ diśam abhipretya tvaritāḥ saṃpratasthire
english: Thus urged by the king, all the leaders of the monkey bands set out swiftly, each heading toward his own assigned quarter.

sanskrit: nadantaś connadantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṃgamāḥ kṣvelanto dhāvamānāś ca yayuḥ plavagasattamāḥ ānayiṣyāmahe sītāṃ haniṣyāmaś ca rāvaṇam
english: Shouting and roaring and thundering, the leaping monkeys — those best of leapers — went on, bounding and running, crying: "We shall bring back Sītā and slay Rāvaṇa!"

sanskrit: aham eko haniṣyāmi prāptaṃ rāvaṇam āhave tataś conmathya sahasā hariṣye janakātmajām
english: "I alone will slay Rāvaṇa when I encounter him in battle, and then I shall swiftly seize and bring away the daughter of Janaka."

sanskrit: vepamānaṃ śrameṇādya bhavadbhiḥ sthīyatām iti eka evāhariṣyāmi pātālād api jānakīm
english: "Let those of you trembling with fatigue stay where you are — I alone shall bring back Jānakī even from Pātāla itself."

sanskrit: vidhamiṣyāmy ahaṃ vṛkṣān dārayiṣyāmy ahaṃ girīn dharaṇīṃ dārayiṣyāmi kṣobhayiṣyāmi sāgarān
english: "I shall tear up trees, I shall split open mountains, I shall cleave the earth asunder, I shall churn the oceans into turmoil."

sanskrit: ahaṃ yojanasaṃkhyāyāḥ plavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ śataṃ yojanasaṃkhyāyāḥ śataṃ samadhikaṃ hy aham
english: "I am capable of leaping a hundred yojanas in count — nay, more than a hundred yojanas — of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit: bhūtale sāgare vāpi śaileṣu ca vaneṣu ca pātālasyāpi vā madhye na mamācchidyate gatiḥ
english: "Whether on the surface of the earth, in the ocean, upon the mountains, in the forests, or even in the depths of Pātāla — my movement cannot be arrested."

sanskrit: ity ekaikaṃ tadā tatra vānarā baladarpitāḥ ūcuś ca vacanaṃ tasmin harirājasya saṃnidhau
english: Thus each of them, one by one, spoke their boastful words in the presence of the king of monkeys, intoxicated with the pride of their strength.

sanskrit: gateṣu vānarendreṣu rāmaḥ sugrīvam abravīt kathaṃ bhavān vinājīte sarvaṃ vai maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ
english: When the monkey lords had departed, Rāma said to Sugrīva: "How did you, without any battle, come to know the entire orb of the earth?"

sanskrit: sugrīvas tu tato rāmam uvāca praṇatātmavān śrūyatāṃ sarvam ākhyāsye vistareṇa nararṣabha
english: Sugrīva then spoke to Rāma with a humble heart: "Hear, O bull among men — I shall recount everything in full detail."

sanskrit: yadā tu dundubhiṃ nāma dānavaṃ mahiṣākṛtim parikālayate vālī malayaṃ prati parvatam
english: "When Vāli was pursuing the dānava named Dundubhi, who had taken the form of a great buffalo, in the direction of Mount Malaya —"

sanskrit: tadā viveśa mahiṣo malayasya guhāṃ prati viveśa vālī tatrāpi malayaṃ tajjighāṃsayā
english: "— then the buffalo entered a cave of Mount Malaya, and Vāli too entered there into Malaya, intent on killing him."

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ tatra nikṣipto guhād vārivinītavat na ca niṣkramate vālī tadā saṃvatsare gate
english: "I was left posted at that cave, like a water-vessel set at a gate, and Vāli did not emerge — a full year having passed."

sanskrit: tataḥ kṣatajavegena āpupūre tadā bilam tad ahaṃ vismito dṛṣṭvā bhrātṛśokaviṣārditaḥ
english: "Then that cave became filled with a torrent of blood; seeing this I was overcome with amazement and tormented by grief for my brother."

sanskrit: athāhaṃ kṛtabuddhis tu suvyaktaṃ nihato guruḥ śilāparvatasaṃkāśā biladvāri mayā kṛtā aśaknuvan niṣkramituṃ mahiṣo vinaśed iti
english: "Then, having resolved that my elder brother had surely been slain, I placed at the mouth of the cave a boulder resembling a mountain, so that the buffalo, unable to emerge, would perish within."

sanskrit: tato 'ham āgāṃ kiṣkindhāṃ nirāśas tasya jīvite rājyaṃ ca sumahat prāptaṃ tārā ca rumayā saha mitraiś ca sahitas tatra vasāmi vigatajvaraḥ
english: "Then I came to Kiṣkindhā, despairing of his life. A great kingdom fell to me, and together with Tārā, with Rumā, and with allies, I dwelt there, freed from anxiety."

sanskrit: ājagāma tato vālī hatvā taṃ dānavarṣabham tato 'ham adadāṃ rājyaṃ gauravād bhayayantritaḥ
english: "Then Vāli returned, having slain that bull among dānavas, and I surrendered the kingdom to him out of deference, constrained by fear."

sanskrit: sa māṃ jighāṃsur duṣṭātmā vālī pravyathitendriyaḥ parilākayate krodhād dhāvantaṃ sacivaiḥ saha
english: "That wicked-souled Vāli, his senses disturbed, wishing to slay me, pursued me in anger together with his ministers as I fled."

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ vālinā tena sānubandhaḥ pradhāvitaḥ nadīś ca vividhāḥ paśyan vanāni nagarāṇi ca
english: "Then I was chased by Vāli together with his retinue, beholding various rivers, forests, and cities as I fled."

sanskrit: ādarśatalasaṃkāśā tato vai pṛthivī mayā alātacakrapratimā dṛṣṭā goṣpadavat tadā
english: "Then the earth appeared to me like the surface of a mirror, resembling a whirling firebrand, and in my speed it seemed no larger than a cow's hoofprint."

sanskrit: tataḥ pūrvam ahaṃ gatvā dakṣiṇām aham āśritaḥ diśaṃ ca paścimāṃ bhūyo gato 'smi bhayaśaṅkitaḥ uttarāṃ tu diśaṃ yāntaṃ hanumān mām athābravīt
english: "Then I first went east, then took refuge in the south, and again turned to the west, trembling with fear; and as I was heading north, Hanūmān spoke to me."

sanskrit: idānīṃ me smṛtaṃ rājan yathā vālī harīśvaraḥ mataṅgena tadā śapto hy asminn āśramamaṇḍale
english: "Now I recall, O king, how Vāli, that lord of monkeys, was formerly cursed by the sage Mataṅga within this hermitage precinct."

sanskrit: praviśed yadi vā vālī mūrdhāsya śatadhā bhavet tatra vāsaḥ sukho 'smākaṃ nirudvigno bhaviṣyati
english: "If Vāli should enter here, his head would shatter into a hundred pieces; our dwelling there would be easy and free from fear."

sanskrit: tataḥ parvatam āsādya ṛśyamūkaṃ nṛpātmaja na viveśa tadā vālī mataṅgasya bhayāt tadā
english: "Then, reaching Mount Ṛśyamūka, O son of a king, Vāli did not enter it then — out of fear of the curse of Mataṅga."

sanskrit: evaṃ mayā tadā rājan pratyakṣam upalakṣitam pṛthivīmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ guhām asmy āgatas tataḥ
english: "Thus, O king, the entire orb of the earth was directly observed by me at that time, and then I came to take refuge in this cave."
